results.title: Andar na Pedra: A História do Raimundos
results.original_title: Andar na Pedra: A História do Raimundos
results.overview: The documentary miniseries traces the group's journey from its formation in Brasília in the late '80s to the height of its fame, when iconic albums like "Lavô Tá Novo" and "Só No Forévis" dominated radio and the Brazilian charts throughout the '90s, selling millions of copies. With a narrative full of twists and turns, the production delves into the highs and lows of a trajectory shaped by success, money, and internal conflicts.

results.title: Matched: True Love
results.overview: At a secluded island resort, a matchmaking tour turns into a deadly game when buried secrets surface — forcing a survivor of past app-related murders to fight for her life once again.

results.title: Election Day
results.overview: In the general elections in Türkiye, İlker, who wants to be a ballot box officer, encounters an old friend during the training session. This encounter will make İlker question his ability to make “elections” in his personal life.

results.title: Sandiwara
results.overview: In a night market, five characters recount their own unique story and represent a facet of Malaysian culture rarely explored.

results.title: Eklo-I
results.overview: In the aftermath of a mysterious virus outbreak in 2030, humanity fled Earth. By 2090, the sole surviving human lives in the mountains of Nepal. When two astronauts, having settled in space, return to Earth, they inadvertently encounter this last human survivor. As they delve into the mountain mysteries, they uncover the chilling enigma of the zombies that now roam the land.

results.overview: Skye Hoshi VOL.2 Anime Syndicate Strikes!

results.title: In Spite of Ourselves
results.overview: Hannah is a determined Portland baker, and Archie, an up-and-coming Los Angeles comedian with a tendency to dodge commitment. What begins as immediate, undeniable chemistry turns into two blissful weeks together—until real life intervenes. Pulled back into their separate worlds, the pair must navigate distance, doubts, and their own hilariously messy insecurities to determine whether love can truly go the distance.

results.title: Charitha Kamakshi
results.overview: Charitha is an innocent girl begins her married life with a passionate filmmaker. As she tries to adjust to her new love and world, she slowly discovers that although her husband is kind at heart, he is morally compromised in his profession. His choices eventually land him in police custody. With little knowledge of the outside world, she must step beyond her innocence and confront a stubborn Sub-Inspector to bring him back

results.title: Bunnylovr
results.overview: A drifting Chinese American cam girl struggles to navigate an increasingly toxic relationship with one of her clients while rekindling her relationship with her dying estranged father.

results.title: Stalker
results.overview: She thought she could leave the past behind… but the past refuses to let go.  A secret love. A broken promise. An obsession that turns deadly.  Some choices can’t be erased… and some secrets can’t stay hidden forever.

results.title: Honeymoon
results.overview: Marina heads to the US to chase her American Dream, leaving behind a son who cannot live without her. A short pass becomes their only chance to say goodbye.

results.title: Project Hourglass
results.overview: When Jacob, a man presumed dead, reappears three years after leaping from a bridge claiming to be part of a secret government program, his fiancé Katie must decide whether to believe his wild claims - or get him some help.

results.title: Social Media Killed the Movie Star
results.original_title: Social Media Killed the Movie Star
results.overview: The traditional movie star is changing because constant access through platforms like Instagram has replaced Hollywood mystique with digital metrics like follower counts. Directed by journalist Kjersti Flaa, the 2026 documentary Social Media Killed the Movie Star explores how digital culture transformed celebrity.

results.title: Single Black Tenant
results.overview: After landing an affordable apartment in a quiet neighborhood, Esme's initial relief turns to sheer terror as she begins to suspect her new home is shared by a killer set on framing her for murder.

results.title: The One Next Door
results.overview: When a mysterious stranger moves in next door to Robert and Tabitha, boundaries are tested, loyalty is questioned, and danger comes for all.

results.title: I am Jit Bahadur
results.overview: Jit Bahadur’s journey from a struggling dreamer to a celebrated actor reveals the harsh price of fame, as his relentless ambition gradually distances him from the very family that once supported him.
